text:
deploy-bot: Canary rc-2026-08-11-7 finished deploy to canary-eu2. Running post-deploy smoke: prefill-lite_v1 (200 samples). Observed intermittent p95 +210ms and synthetic heartbeat jitter ~1.1%. tagging #eng-releases for triage. :triage_lights:

vivian: seeing the alert now. which model variant? int4-opt or float16?

omar: this is int4-opt-13b. quick trace peek shows a small set of prefills with duplicated eos tokens ("\n<eos><eos>") which line up with the p95 bursts.

qa-noah: local repro (tight loop): `for i in $(seq 1 250); do curl -sS -X POST https://canary.api.redwood/v1/smoke -d '{"prompt":"test"}'; done`  p95 spikes appear in waves.

sre-lee: duplicated EOS will misalign KV cache streams and trigger fallback decode. can we immediately throttle synth so user traffic stays normal?

vivian: lowering synth fanout to 18rps via deploy-bot now.

deploy-bot: synth-fanout updated to 18 for canary-eu2. Verification window 3m starting.

omar: digging into tokenizer: some multi-byte sequences show up as two separate token boundaries in int4 tokenization map only. float16 traces don't show this.

sre-lee: options: rollback canary, divert synth to float16 route, or pin user routes to previous stable. I prefer divert synth->float16 for quick mitigation and keep canary for telemetry.

vivian: agree. prepare route id synth-divert-0811 -> float16-13b and increase tracing for synth to 100% for 5m.

omar: adding quick log hook: `kubectl -n inference logs -l role=prefill -c tokenizer --since=5m | grep -i eos`

deploy-bot: Applied route synth-divert-0811 -> float16-13b; tracing sampling=100% for tag=canary-synth.

qa-noah: after diversion synth p95 back to baseline. sampled traces show no duplicated eos tokens on float16. :white_check_mark:

vivian: file follow-up ticket INF-2026-521 and pause canary ramp until root cause fixed. include repro, sample traces, and perf counters.

sre-lee: also add a temporary guard in the release runbook: if synthetic p95 > baseline+150ms for 4m -> auto-divert synth.

omar: INF-2026-521 created. summary: int4-opt tokenizer emits duplicated EOS for certain utf8 sequences causing KV misalignment and p95 bursts. assigning to omar.

vivian: decision recap: rollout paused for user ramp; synth diverted to float16 for 24h; ticket INF-2026-521 open; tracing at 100% for synth; guard rule added. Will re-run expanded regression harness overnight.

sre-lee: thanks team. once the patch lands we can canary redeploy in a controlled change window. closing loop. :thumbsup:
